import warnings

def test_r8_pyparsing_warning_inheritance():
    from pyparsing import PyparsingWarning
    assert issubclass(PyparsingWarning, UserWarning)

def test_r8_pyparsing_deprecation_warning_inheritance():
    from pyparsing import PyparsingDeprecationWarning, PyparsingWarning
    assert issubclass(PyparsingDeprecationWarning, PyparsingWarning)
    assert issubclass(PyparsingDeprecationWarning, DeprecationWarning)

    from pyparsing import PyparsingDiagnosticWarning, PyparsingWarning
    assert issubclass(PyparsingDiagnosticWarning, PyparsingWarning)

    from pyparsing import PyparsingWarning, PyparsingDeprecationWarning, PyparsingDiagnosticWarning
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        warnings.warn("test", PyparsingWarning)
        assert len(w) == 1
        assert issubclass(w[0].category, PyparsingWarning)
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        warnings.warn("test", PyparsingDeprecationWarning)
        assert len(w) == 1
        assert issubclass(w[0].category, PyparsingDeprecationWarning)
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        warnings.warn("test", PyparsingDiagnosticWarning)
        assert len(w) == 1
        assert issubclass(w[0].category, PyparsingDiagnosticWarning)
